Release v1.2.0b (19 November 2019) |previous_update = [[Release v1.1|Halloween 2019 Update]] |next_update = [[Release v1.3]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Release v1.2''' was the fourteenth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 9th of November 2019. It introduced the [[DJ Booth]] tower, a few skin and emotes, and small game improvements. As with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was no official name for updates. As a result, the name '''Release v1.2''' has been retroactively applied to this update. This version encompassed three updates, the main Release v1.2.0 update (released 9 November 2019) and two minor updates, Release v1.2.0a (released 12 November 2019) and Release v1.2.0b (released 19 November 2019). ==Additions== ===Towers=== *[[DJ Booth]] ===Crates=== *New skins for the [[Premium Crate]] **Skins: ***[[Minigunner]]: {{Color|Premium|Heavy}} ***[[DJ Booth]]: {{Color|Premium|Neon Rave}} ***[[Crook Boss]]: {{Color|Premium|Checker}} ===Emotes=== *[[Cat Dance]] *[[Power Dance]] *[[Boston Breakdance]] *[[Epic Backflips]] ===Miscellaneous=== *[[Discount Buff]] *[[Cost Debuff]] *Boosted {{Exp|}} fridays and saturdays *Shadow map lighting *New [[Codes|code]]: R3TR0 **Gives {{Exp|50}} ==Removals== ===Enemies=== :Multiple enemies were removed as they were a part of the [[Halloween 2019 Event]]. *[[Nightmare Carnival]] ===Miscellaneous=== *[[Halloween 2019 Event]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== ===Towers=== *[[Military Base]] units no longer give infinite {{Money|Cash}} upon collision. *[[Commander]] now properly provides [[Firerate Buff]]s according to upgrades instead of 10% on all Levels. *[[Commander]] now reduces [[Soldier]]'s cooldown four-fold. *[[Damage Buff|Damage buffs]] now can stack. *[[Sentry]]'s Spool-Up mechanic has been restored. *[[Militant|John]]'s Level 3 damage increased from +2 to +3. *[[Crook Boss]]'s [[Mafia]] damage increased from 2 to 3. *[[Military Base]] buffed. **'''Level 3''' ***Firerate decreased from 0.45 to 0.25. **'''Level 4''' ***Damage increased from 2 to 3. ***Firerate decreased from 0.45 to 0.25. **'''Level 5''' **Because of a bug this did not work and the skin had the same upgrade costs as the regular [[Scout]]. *Fixed [[Militant|John]] not gaining hidden detection at Level 2. :In '''Release v1.2.0a''':
